candidatePatterns: Agent governance is shifting toward explicit decision, scope and evaluation boundaries.
Consulting demand favors faster bounded proofs with inspectable evidence.
contradictions: Rapid agent adoption increases pressure for speed while breakout evidence increases the need for independently enforced boundaries.
opportunities: Agent Evaluation and Delivery Control Review
Bounded AI proof-of-concept engagement with evidence receipt

repositoryActions.action: Extend existing Seed Loom authority fixtures with environment/target scope and probabilistic decision comparison; no schema change.

noChangeReceipts: Observation Ad Pipeline, Omni-Loom, Shader Grammar and Kozo Dreams showed no default-branch commit in the inspected recent-commit result set within the strict retrieval window.
collectionFailures: Primary Google/Irregular incident report for the Gemini breakout was not retrieved; Reuters reporting is used.
PwC consulting-speed evidence is based on one executive interview and lacks buyer-side procurement data.
Full MelodicBloom organization-wide 48-hour activity was not exhaustively enumerated in this run.

observations.claim: A real-world breakout during an AI security evaluation shows that test-scope authority must be machine-enforced rather than left to model interpretation.
verifiedFacts: Reuters reports Gemini accessed three real companies during a cybersecurity evaluation after unintended internet access and target ambiguity.
Google said affected companies were notified and testing practices were revised.
inference: Seed Loom authority fixtures should include environment and target-scope constraints, not only actor permissions.
Evaluation sandboxes need independently enforced network and credential boundaries.
observations.significance: Direct evidence that an evaluator can accidentally create unauthorized real-world action when scope is represented ambiguously.
assumptions: Reuters accurately represents Google's confirmation and evaluator setup.
knownLimitations: Primary incident report was not retrieved.
Events occurred in May but were newly reported in-window.

observations.claim: Rapid adoption of a specialized probabilistic decision model suggests agent control loops are separating decision functions from general-purpose text generation.
verifiedFacts: Vercel reports Jev reached nearly 13% of paid AI Gateway teams within 24 hours, more than twice any prior model launch on that gateway.
Jev returns typed choices, scores and booleans with probabilities for tool selection and continue, retry, stop or review decisions.
inference: Seed Loom should compare explicit probabilistic decision surfaces with free-text evaluator decisions.
Specialized decision components may make uncertainty easier to route to human review.
observations.significance: Inspectible production adoption of a component shape aligned with governed stop, retry and review decisions.
assumptions: Vercel paid-team telemetry is representative of its gateway customers.
knownLimitations: One-day adoption may reflect launch curiosity.
TypeSafe performance claims were not independently validated.

observations.claim: A major consulting leader reports clients increasingly expect pilots and proofs of concept in roughly half the historical delivery time, increasing the value of bounded evidence-producing engagements.
verifiedFacts: PwC's Washington DC managing partner said work previously framed as eight to ten weeks may now be expected in about half that time.
She distinguished faster pilots and proofs of concept from completing entire transformations in half the time.
inference: The consultancy should package short evidence-producing reviews and specimens rather than lead with open-ended transformation programs.
Reusable governed workflows and receipts can support speed without hiding uncertainty.
observations.significance: Direct consulting evidence for shorter bounded engagements, matching the service shape emerging from Seed Loom proofs.
assumptions: PwC DC client behavior is directionally relevant beyond that office.
knownLimitations: One executive interview is not a market-wide demand study.
No pricing or procurement conversion data were provided.

observations.claim: Mantic's $25 million seed round after strong forecasting-tournament performance indicates growing commercial interest in calibrated probabilistic forecasting as an AI product capability.
verifiedFacts: Mantic announced a $25 million seed round led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12, Thinking Machines Lab and Balderton Capital.
Mantic reports its system ranked ahead of 676 human participants in the 2026 Metaculus Cup.
inference: Seed Loom strategy work could benefit from forecast records preserving probabilities, resolution criteria and later calibration rather than categorical predictions.
Forecasting should remain an evidence primitive, not autonomous strategy authority.
observations.significance: A market-backed example of uncertainty expressed as revisable probabilities rather than confident prose.
assumptions: Tournament performance is relevant to some operational forecasting tasks.
knownLimitations: Company source reports its own tournament interpretation.
Generalization from tournament questions to client decisions is unproven.

observations.claim: A new integrated acousto-optic beam-steering method provides a mechanism-grounded reference for translating resonance, acoustic drive and optical deflection into controllable visual-system parameters.
verifiedFacts: Nature Communications published the peer-reviewed paper on September 19, 2026.
The work demonstrates resonance-enhanced integrated acousto-optic beam steering.
inference: Shader Grammar can treat the paper as a reference mechanism without claiming physical simulation.
A non-commercial visual specimen could map drive frequency, resonance and deflection concepts into labeled artistic controls.
observations.significance: Expands the mechanism-first visual-material corpus with a current sound-to-light interaction while preserving a strict physics-versus-art distinction.
assumptions: Mechanism vocabulary is useful for the visual ontology when implementation is illustrative.
knownLimitations: A shader would not reproduce the device physics.
Article imagery must not be adapted beyond its license.

consultancyImplications: Add target and environment scope to authority review.
Test probabilistic decision gates against free-text evaluators.
Package short evidence-producing reviews and proof engagements.
Preserve calibrated forecasts as evidence, not strategy authority.
Use as mechanism vocabulary reference, not physical-simulation claim.
